$comment: §4.3/§5 — the PlayView packet's control envelope (socket-only; the guest never sees it). Cap: MaxControlEnvelopeBytes (20480) = 16384 for ≤64 retained entries + 4096 for syntax and the mandatory fields. Statuses ride every frame until acknowledged (StatusAck high-water mark).
title: control_view

gen.$comment: u64: the seat's CURRENT control generation (registration 1; bumped on activation, death, respawn, reconnect, replacement, kick)

statuses.$comment: unacknowledged entries, ordinal order; omit when empty

counters.$comment: saturating u32 JSON numbers, ALWAYS present (a golden pins the worst case): deterministic-overflow and backpressure aggregates (§4.3) — never an unbounded list of dropped ids

dropped_chat.$comment: lobby-chat messages dropped at the rate caps (§9.2)

faults_dropped.$comment: faults past even the reserved 16 slots

backpressure.$comment: admissions refused for want of status capacity or compile-plane budget
